notes: The prior control is a saved character image per control operand (the emitted get/set pair over the operand's place); the chronologically first GENERATE saves without testing, later ones test major to minor and stop at the first change, and break processing runs for that level and every lower one. 'Equality with the corresponding prior control' is the comparison the item's category takes: an image-carried numeric control (zoned, packed or a REDEFINES view) decodes both saved images through its profile and compares the values (CobolReport.NumericControlEqual), so a control that goes from +0 to -0 is no change and causes no break (kb/Work PB5782, which the 1985 code reads re-recorded this row PARTIAL for on 2026-11-16, ruled in kb/Work/PB5683/2026-11-16-rulings-code-reads-batch-8.md; witness pb5782_numeric_control_signed_zero, the same at every edition); every other numeric item's image is a function of its value. kb/Work PB205 made the SAVED item the right one for a reference-modified operand: GR3 gives the prior control 'the same data description as the corresponding data item', which for such an operand is the 8.4.3.3.4 GR5 unique data item - the slice - and the golden's two overlapping-item controls could not be told apart otherwise. kb/Work PB688 (2026-09-05): the golden moved from tests/conformance/2002 to tests/conformance/2023 - it observes the report by re-reading the report file through ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL, which is a COBOL-2023 introduction (12.4.5.10.3 GR2; the Foreword's main-changes list over ISO/IEC 1989:2014), so the program is not expressible at 2002. The RULE's editions are unchanged.
